description: Parent-child subagent delegation: single main agent spawns subagents to handle parallel subtasks

agents.task:
I need you to analyze the AgentSight codebase and produce a report. Please use your subagent capability to delegate the following tasks:

1. Spawn a subagent to read /home/lzk/agentsight/collector/Cargo.toml and list all dependencies
2. Spawn a subagent to read /home/lzk/agentsight/frontend/package.json and list all dependencies
3. After all subagents complete, combine the findings and write a brief summary to /tmp/deps-analysis.txt

Important: delegate each task to a separate subagent.
